_help: Topic pages (/topic/<slug>) for running stories. A story belongs to a topic when its headline or summary contains one of the keywords (any capitals). Only put facts here that have been checked against official or news-agency reports; 'facts' is a short timeline shown at the top of the page.

hubs.title: Tripura civic polls 2026
hubs.intro: Every InsightNE story on the 2026 elections to the urban local bodies of Tripura, newest first.

facts.text: The State Election Commission announces the schedule.

hubs.factsNote: 21 urban local bodies and 345 seats, including 51 wards of the Agartala Municipal Corporation, as reported by news agencies after the announcement. Dates can change: the State Election Commission's notices are final.
